status.baseline_status: Frozen strongest out-of-sample paper-monitoring candidate; not modified by this roadmap.
status.new_data_conclusion: New data does not yet provide enough independently validated Tier-1 upside features to justify a strategy test.
status.expansion_tier1_conclusion: Expansion Tier-1 overlay does not improve the frozen strategy economically.

data_priorities.examples: Spot BTC/ETH ETF flows; CME positioning; CFTC positioning; CoinShares flow reports; exchange reserve changes
data_priorities.new_information: Regulated/institutional demand and inventory pressure not captured by Binance OHLCV or macro gates.
data_priorities.minimum_history: Daily or weekly 2019-2026 preferred; ETF flows start 2024, so require explicit limited-sample treatment.
data_priorities.point_in_time_requirements: Publication timestamp, fund identifier mapping, AUM denominator vintage, holiday handling, and no revised backfill without vintage labels.
data_priorities.first_test: Feature research against upside targets before any overlay.
data_priorities.current_status: Not acquired in usable structured form; prior module found no usable ETF-flow time series.

data_priorities.examples: MVRV; realized cap; NVT; SOPR; exchange inflows/outflows; whale activity; active entities; long-term holder metrics
data_priorities.new_information: Holder cost basis, exchange saleable inventory, network usage, accumulation/distribution, and valuation state.
data_priorities.minimum_history: Daily BTC/ETH 2019-2026 with metric methodology documentation.
data_priorities.point_in_time_requirements: Provider revision policy, entity-label vintage, chain split/token migration handling, and timestamped availability.
data_priorities.first_test: Tiered feature validation; exchange-flow and MVRV features must beat public active-address/transaction proxies.
data_priorities.current_status: Only public BTC active-address/transaction proxies available; these were Tier 2, not Tier 1.

data_priorities.examples: Implied volatility; skew; risk reversals; put/call ratios; volatility term structure
data_priorities.new_information: Forward-looking risk premia, crash insurance demand, upside call demand, and term-structure stress.
data_priorities.minimum_history: Daily BTC/ETH constant-maturity surfaces through development and holdout.
data_priorities.point_in_time_requirements: Quote timestamp, stale quote filters, expiry/strike survivorship, settlement convention, and surface construction reproducibility.
data_priorities.first_test: Calibration and AUC for upside/leadership targets; compare with realized-volatility controls.
data_priorities.current_status: Public Deribit historical-vol endpoint was reachable but too short for 2019-2026; no options feature accepted.

data_priorities.examples: Sector leadership; breadth expansion; correlation regimes; dominance measures; relative-strength leadership
data_priorities.new_information: Rotation, breadth diffusion, and leadership state across the crypto universe.
data_priorities.minimum_history: Point-in-time universe with liquidity, sector taxonomy, and delisting/survivorship controls.
data_priorities.point_in_time_requirements: Lagged universe construction, sector taxonomy vintage, stable/wrapped exclusion, and reconstitution audit.
data_priorities.first_test: Feature research and regime-specific IC before portfolio overlay.
data_priorities.current_status: Existing crypto-native leadership features were researched; prior expansion overlay did not improve the frozen strategy economically.

model_hierarchy.models: Logistic Regression; Elastic Net Logistic Regression; Random Forest; Gradient Boosting; XGBoost; LightGBM
model_hierarchy.allowed_when: Always first model family for tabular datasets.
model_hierarchy.acceptance_requirement: Must improve holdout Sharpe, CAGR, and max drawdown simultaneously without trivial exposure reduction.

model_hierarchy.models: MLP; shallow neural networks; TabNet; Temporal Fusion Transformer
model_hierarchy.allowed_when: Only after genuinely new datasets provide enough observations and Level 1 models show non-random signal.
model_hierarchy.acceptance_requirement: Better calibration, holdout economic value, and stable CPCV; not just better in-sample fit.
model_hierarchy.complexity_status: Conditional; not justified by current small new-data sample.

model_hierarchy.allowed_when: Exploratory only, with dense timestamped sequence data and enough non-overlapping episodes.
model_hierarchy.acceptance_requirement: Better calibration, holdout performance, and economic performance versus Level 1 and frozen baseline.
model_hierarchy.complexity_status: Research-only until data density materially improves.

model_hierarchy.allowed_when: Research-only after deterministic policy/action space and realistic cost/exposure constraints are locked.
model_hierarchy.acceptance_requirement: Holdout Sharpe and CAGR improve, drawdown remains controlled, turnover remains realistic, and policy is interpretable.
model_hierarchy.complexity_status: Not acceptable unless it beats the frozen strategy under strict out-of-sample controls.

model_hierarchy.models: Sentiment extraction; topic classification; event detection; regime classification
model_hierarchy.allowed_when: Only when timestamped text data exists with reliable publication times.
model_hierarchy.acceptance_requirement: Text-derived features must pass independent feature validation; LLMs cannot generate discretionary trades.

validation_protocol.requirement: btc_eth_macro_gate_balanced remains unchanged; every candidate compares to it.
Fixed development period ending 2024-12-31 unless a dataset starts later, in which case the limited sample must be labelled.
2025-01-01 onward; never used for feature/model/threshold selection.
No strategy test unless new data passes independent development-only feature validation.
Combinatorial purged cross-validation inside development with purging and embargo.
Report all tested configurations; do not promote highest holdout Sharpe.
PBO, deflated Sharpe probability, bootstrap confidence intervals where feasible, and configuration count.
Cost sensitivity at 10/25/50/100 bps, turnover, exposure, cash allocation, drawdown, and worst-month diagnostics.
Reject improvements caused only by going mostly to cash or reducing exposure dramatically.
A candidate is interesting only if holdout Sharpe, CAGR, and max drawdown improve simultaneously.

study_templates.feature_validation: Net flow, flow/AUM, flow acceleration, flow percentile, inflow streak, outflow shock versus upside targets.
study_templates.model_path: Start with Level 1 classifiers; only use Level 2 if daily observations are sufficient.
study_templates.economic_test: Layer on frozen macro gate; risk-on weeks can increase exposure or tilt ETH only if probabilities pass development thresholds.
study_templates.reject_if: Flow data is delayed/revised, insufficiently mapped to BTC/ETH, or improves only by reducing exposure.

study_templates.new_information_added: MVRV, realized cap, NVT, SOPR, exchange flows, whale/holder/entity metrics.
study_templates.feature_validation: Development-only AUC/IC/Newey-West/CPCV stability; compare against public active-address and transaction proxies.
study_templates.model_path: Level 1 first; sequence models only if dense daily multi-metric history is available.
study_templates.economic_test: Only Tier-1 on-chain features may enter expansion overlays.
study_templates.reject_if: Entity-label revisions or metric methodology create lookahead risk, or holdout effect disappears.

study_templates.new_information_added: Constant-maturity IV, skew, risk reversal, put/call ratio, and term-structure data.
study_templates.feature_validation: Test whether implied information improves upside/leadership targets after realized-volatility controls.
study_templates.model_path: Level 1 first; shallow sequence models only if option-surface panel is sufficiently dense.
study_templates.economic_test: Use options state to increase upside participation only when macro gate allows exposure.
study_templates.reject_if: Signal is stale, surface construction is unstable, or it only restates realized volatility.

study_templates.new_information_added: Sector leadership, breadth expansion, dominance, correlation and dispersion states.
study_templates.feature_validation: Universe-vintage-aware feature research across top 10/20/30; no survivorship-biased sector labels.
study_templates.model_path: Level 1 classifiers and interpretable ensemble scores.
study_templates.economic_test: Allow top-universe sleeves only if leadership target passes development CPCV.
study_templates.reject_if: Turnover is high, leadership is unstable, or top-universe sleeve fails holdout drawdown controls.

study_templates.feature_validation: Timestamp audit, event-label stability, and independent AUC/IC versus upside/risk targets.
study_templates.model_path: LLMs extract features only; trading model remains conventional and predeclared.
study_templates.economic_test: Text features must improve frozen-strategy overlay after costs.
study_templates.reject_if: Text publication time is ambiguous or feature extraction is not reproducible.
